comparison.objective: Cut a cable tie without nicking the cable bundle; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual bundle stabilization, cutter pickup, jaw placement, squeezing, and tool return versus hex-key manipulation, collar adjustment, locking, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Tie severed within the safe zone and cutter returned with bundle intact versus two safe locked stops. Candidate lacks complete numeric rebound/overload/drift limits.
comparison.reason: Shared stabilization and tool use are generic; cutting localization and damping calibration are materially different.
